scope: Second BU core implementation pass: GSU-Mugar Link entrance, approach and arrival routes; Bay State/Silber kerb continuity
evidenceLimits: Current BU text identifies The Link as the front entrance, with Mugar to the right and Food Hall to the left; the library identifies its Commonwealth-facing entrance.
The entry anchor is the centre of the existing GIS Link south edge. Door width, leaf count, sign, frames, thresholds and individual paving dimensions are authored approximations, not a facade survey.
The 2012 PNF supports the forecourt and brick paving relationship; it is not a current as-built record. New approach paving preserves the existing DEM.
Building footprints, heights and occupied-volume collision remain unchanged. Interiors are not implemented.
Kerb faces and lowered entry profiles are authored detail around existing GIS roads and footbridge paths. The mobile scene retains its existing lightweight street representation.

changes.entry: Recessed glazed Link door group, narrow head, frames and shared sign; removed misleading large GSU/Mugar facade entry labels.
changes.ground: Connected the approximately 11m former grass gap with brick approach paving. A local 1.6m landing reaches the door sill above the surrounding grade without moving the Sert foundation.
changes.navigation: Mugar and GSU outdoor arrivals face the Link; new guide branch ends outside its closed doors. Bidirectional links to Law and Pappas remain unobstructed.
changes.street: Extended physical kerb faces along selected Bay State/Silber segments and their Commonwealth junction; lowered kerbs at cross streets and existing bridge landings.
changes.mobile: Rebaked Boston; brick ground uses XZ projection in HD and concrete no longer receives masonry joints. No new texture or rendering pass.

validation.unitTests: 92 relevant tests passed across navigation, arrival, geography, streets, architecture, entrance ground rays and mobile decoding; not a complete repository suite in this pass.
validation.build: npm run build:cloudflare passed, including TypeScript. 95 assets / 136.80 MiB staged, not deployed.
validation.fixedViews: 8 same-camera before/after captures; zero page/shader errors or invalid geometry vertices.
validation.mobilePlay: Touch Chromium: all 29 BU destinations, movement, HD switch, Link HD rendering, save persistence, safe low-quality reload and viewport fit passed.
validation.mobileBudget: Touch Chromium observed heap peak 76.99 MiB and backing storage 71.74 MiB; no desktop MIT/detail GLBs. Not a physical iPhone stability test.
validation.comparisonReport: 6 image pairs, slider, image loading and 390px layout passed.
